ValidationRule.description: Ensure the channel of answer field is filled if the status is 'Closed'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_Quality", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Latam_E_Commerce"), ISPICKVAL(Status , "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Channel_of_Answer__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The cases must not be closed without providing the channel of answer data
